issues.detail: The Greek verb 'πειθεις' is in the aorist active subjunctive, expressing a request or desire ('persuade me'). The Vietnamese translation 'ngươi thuyết phục ta' (you persuade me) is rendered as a statement of fact or a present action, missing the nuance of the request/exhortation. Furthermore, 'εν ολιγω' is an adverbial phrase meaning 'in a short time' or 'quickly', which is translated as 'trong ít lời' (in few words), changing the sense from duration/speed to quantity of speech.
